title: Strategic projects in Europe's anode supply chain: Up Catalyst
gist: Video page for a Benchmark interview in which Up Catalyst CTO Sebastian Pohlmann discusses Europe's graphite and anode scene and the role of EU strategic projects; the text is only a short description plus a listing of other Benchmark conference sessions (copper, lithium price cycle, cross-border capital, electrolytes/fluorine, graphite & anode technology). No substantive arguments are given in the text.

insights.claim: Up Catalyst CTO Sebastian Pohlmann frames EU strategic project designations as a meaningful element of Europe's emerging graphite and anode supply chain.
insights.speaker: Sebastian Pohlmann, CTO, Up Catalyst; Matthew Bird, Senior Editor, Benchmark
insights.so_what: EU strategic project status is a signal for which European anode/graphite players may access permitting and financing support.
insights.locator: Up Catalyst CTO Sebastian Pohlmann discusses

insights.claim: Benchmark's conference programming highlights copper supply constraints alongside demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and data centres as a key electrification theme.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Copper's multi-sector demand (EVs, grid, data centres) against constrained supply is a consensus industry framing.
insights.quote: Copper’s role in electrification: supply constraints and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres.

insights.claim: Anode technology direction, including silicon-carbon composites, hard carbon and lithium-metal, and their commercialisation timelines, is positioned as a driver of future upstream raw material demand.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Faster adoption of next-gen anodes would shift demand away from conventional graphite; track commercialisation timelines.

insights.claim: Do-Fluoride highlighted market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts and upstream fluorine security as issues for scaling fast-charging and energy storage materials.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Fluorine supply security is an under-watched chokepoint in battery electrolyte supply chains.

source_meta.author: Sebastian Pohlmann, CTO, Up Catalyst; Matthew Bird, Senior Editor, Benchmark
